label: Diagram 2.4
caption: Diagram 2.4 | Clear access zones to principal bedroom Sanitary facilities General provisions
description: This drawing is a plan (floor layout) of a principal bedroom. A bed is drawn at the centre, with two pillow shapes at its top edge. A door on the left wall is shown open with a quarter-circle swing arc. A rectangular piece of furniture is set against the left wall below the door. A window is drawn in the right wall. Light grey shaded areas form the access zone around the bed: a band along the left side, a band along the right side, and a band across the foot. The left and right bands near the head of the bed are each marked with the letter "a" and a horizontal dashed line. Dimensions of 750mm are shown horizontally on the left and right of the bed and vertically at the foot; a vertical dimension of 600mm appears at the top right, measuring from the top wall to the dashed line. To the right of the plan, a "Notes:" block gives three numbered notes on clear access to the window, bedside furniture in zone 'a', and bed size per the furniture schedule in Appendix D. A footnote reads "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted". The green footer bar reads "Diagram 2.4 Clear access zones to principal bedroom".
